messages:
elaine: hey @raj @noah can someone take a quick look at this PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js/pull/1421
It's a small fix for streaming tool-calls in the js-sdk — switches timeout/backoff to use AbortController across stream chunks + an e2e for late tool responses. Need approval to cut a patch release tomorrow morning.

raj: on my list, i'll review today. quick q — what's the main behavioral change? does this touch server APIs?

elaine: mostly client-side. no server API changes. changed how we abort streaming tool calls (avoids double-end errors). added tests at scripts/e2e/toolcall-timeout.test.ts. CI is flaky on windows node18 but green elsewhere.

noah: skimmed and left a comment about error classification (distinguish user-timeout vs system). also can you add a brief changelog entry in the PR body?

camille: i can rerun the windows job after the fixes, ping me when ready.

elaine: got it — added changelog and addressed error classification in the last commit. PTAL @raj @noah

raj: LGTM, approved. left one tiny nit about a log message but not blocking.

noah: approved too. :shipit:

ci-bot: merge queued — running final CI checks.

ci-bot: merge succeeded — published redwood-js v0.18.7

elaine: thank you everyone! i'll keep an eye on client error rates for the next few hours and file a follow-up if anything odd shows up.
